events.content: Created `app/actions.ts:1`. Used `updateTag` from `next/cache` — in this Next.js 16 canary version it's the Server Action–only function that expires the cache entry synchronously, guaranteeing the next request fetches fresh data instead of serving stale content (the "read-your-own-writes" semantic). `revalidateTag` would only mark entries stale and could still serve cached content during background revalidation, which doesn't meet your requirement.
